name: ssh-proxy-router
title: SSH Proxy Router
description: Route selected websites through an SSH SOCKS proxy while all other traffic remains direct.
author: mariusrueve

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: SSH Proxy Router
commands.subtitle: Menu Bar
commands.description: Show and control selective SSH proxy routing in the menu bar

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle SSH Proxy Router
commands.subtitle: Selective Website Routing
commands.description: Start or stop selective website routing through SSH

preferences.name: sshUser
preferences.title: SSH User
preferences.description: User account on the SSH gateway

preferences.name: sshHost
preferences.title: SSH Gateway
preferences.description: SSH gateway used to reach the routed websites

preferences.name: sshPort
preferences.title: SSH Port
preferences.description: Port used to connect to the SSH gateway

preferences.name: identityFile
preferences.title: SSH Identity File
preferences.description: Optional private-key path; leave empty to use your SSH agent/config

preferences.name: routedHosts
preferences.title: Routed Websites
preferences.description: Comma-separated exact hosts or wildcards; URLs are also accepted

preferences.name: primaryURL
preferences.title: Primary Website URL
preferences.description: Optional website opened by the main menu action; defaults to the first routed host

preferences.name: socksPort
preferences.title: Local SOCKS Port
preferences.description: Local port for the SSH dynamic forward

preferences.name: pacPort
preferences.title: Local PAC Port
preferences.description: Local port serving Safari's host-specific proxy configuration

preferences.name: startTimeout
preferences.title: Start Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for the SSH tunnel

preferences.name: networkServices
preferences.title: Network Services
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated macOS network services; empty means every enabled service

preferences.name: openInSafari
preferences.title: Open in Safari
preferences.description: Use Safari for the Open Website menu actions
preferences.label: Open routed websites specifically in Safari

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:all && npm run build && npm test
